name: bokken
description: Run governed, event-sourced Design Thinking loops against your repo, metrics, and interviews; get an evidence-traced dossier, reports, and a build-ready handoff.
long_description: Bokken encodes the Empathize → Define → Ideate → Prototype → Test loop as an executable, governed process. Every model call, decision, and piece of evidence lands in an append-only journal; synthetic contributions are labeled; gates keep autonomous runs under human control. 14 tools over the same core as the CLI. Try it free first: `uvx bokken demo` runs a complete engagement offline for $0.00. Requires uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) — the bundle invokes `uvx bokken serve`, so the server is always the released package.

author.name: Juan Martin Maglione and Marc Puig

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Used for real runs. Leave empty to explore: the demo session costs $0.00 and needs no key.

workspace.title: Bokken workspace
workspace.description: Where sessions (journals, reports, handoffs) are stored.

input_roots.title: Input roots
input_roots.description: Directories Bokken may read as run inputs (repos, metrics, transcripts). Paths outside these roots are refused.

tools.name: create_session_tool
tools.description: Create a session from a brief (inputs confined to the authorized roots)

tools.name: run_session
tools.description: Advance to the next halt: gate, input, stop, or completion

tools.name: step_session
tools.description: Advance by at most one stage

tools.name: stop_session
tools.description: Journaled stop; the session stays resumable

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Where the session is and what blocks progress

tools.name: resolve_gate
tools.description: Approve or reject a pending stage gate (rejection needs a reason)

tools.name: request_loopback
tools.description: Loop back to an earlier stage with a journaled reason

tools.name: submit_input
tools.description: Answer a pending question (attributed to the client identity, journaled as simulated)

tools.name: query_journal
tools.description: Filter the append-only ledger by type, stage, actor, or time

tools.name: generate_dossier
tools.description: Generate the Session Dossier (outcomes, narrative, evidence graph)

tools.name: generate_handoff
tools.description: Generate build-ready OpenSpec specifications for the validated concept

tools.name: export_report
tools.description: Export the PPTX deck and self-contained HTML report

tools.name: cost_report
tools.description: Journal-derived costs with cache hit rate and grounding health
